content: {"praised":["Motion comic has good story and engaging plot.","Voice acting by Djimon Hounsou is strong and authentic.","Visuals are high quality and well animated.","Humor adds lightness to the narrative.","Pacing keeps viewers interested throughout."],"criticized":["Contains heavy political propaganda and bias.","Characters' powers altered from comic book versions.","Captain America portrayed weak and unfaithful.","Animation feels cheap and low quality.","Dialogue unrealistic and implausible plotlines."]}
